name: Testing
description: Looping dot menu selects seven archive media states; central ticker removed.

files.testing.js: Manual composition/mount and seven ID-linked dot choices.
files.testing.css: Shared page reset and menu layering.
files.navigation.html: Seven One–Seven links using the preserved loop structure.

initial_state: Original separate sneeze22-bg default background; no selected option, thumbnails or caption. Reload restores this state.
behavior: Only7 options exist in the mounted interface; central ticker is removed in an inert template before insertion. Other14 captions/backgrounds are pruned.
Dot activation changes associated background image/video, thumbnails and text through the archive controller.
Mobile labels One–Seven; existing infinite loop, fade, cardinal docking and landscape constraints are retained. Desktop dots remain fixed.
Loop scrolling only positions choices. Selection happens on click/tap/Enter, with drag-click suppression intact.
Caption thumbnail zoom is preserved. Hidden videos pause on selection change.
integration: Load index.html as an isolated document. testing.js imports the existing controllers, fetches archive markup and navigation.html, and mounts once. mountTesting(host,archiveMarkup,navigationMarkup) returns destroy(). No external JavaScript dependencies added.
